_comment: Single source of the dependency rules. Read by cmake/AyniLayers.cmake (Core link graph) and tools/check_deps.py (#include graph). See ADR-0008, ADR-0010 and ADR-0011.
_core_subdir_deps: Per module: which sibling entity subdirectories each subdirectory may include, e.g. {"work": {"task": ["call"]}}. Undeclared pairs are forbidden; files at a module's root may include any of its subdirectories.
_components: Header kinds each top-level directory may include. 'own' is the instance's own public headers (ayni/hosts/<name>.h or ayni/hosts/<name>/...); quoted includes that resolve inside the same instance are always allowed. core/, include/ and tests/ have fixed rules in check_deps.py.
